question: Which actors in movies have ratings above 4?
What are the 5 most overrated movies?
cypher:
MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:RATED]-(:User)
WITH m, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating
ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 5
RETURN m.title, avg_rating;

question: List the films that have at least two directors, and optionally the names of the people who gave their opinions on these films.
cypher:
MATCH (m:Movie)
WHERE count{(m)<-[:DIRECTED]-(:Director)} >= 2
OPTIONAL MATCH (m)<-[r:RATED]-(u:User)
RETURN m.title, COLLECT(u.name) AS reviewers;

question: list the number of Tom Hanks' co-actors
What is the average rating value for the movie Sounder?
What is the most recent movie?
cypher:
MATCH (m:Movie)
WHERE m.released IS NOT NULL AND m.released <> "" AND m.released <> "null"
RETURN m.title, m.released
ORDER BY m.released DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which movies are not reviewed by Robert Brooks?
What are the co-actors of Robert de Niro, grouped by movie?
List the directors who directed more than one movie.
cypher:
MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)
WITH d, COUNT(DISTINCT m) AS nb_movies
WHERE nb_movies > 1
RETURN d.name, nb_movies;

question: List the directors older than 80 years old
cypher:
MATCH (d:Director)
WHERE d.born IS NOT NULL AND d.born <> "" AND d.born <> "null"
  AND (d.died IS NULL OR d.died = "" OR d.died = "null")
  AND (date().year - toInteger(left(d.born, 4))) > 80
RETURN d.name, d.born;

question: Which movie genre gets the most ratings by the users?
cypher:
MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie)<-[r:RATED]-(:User)
RETURN g.name AS genre, COUNT(r) AS nb_ratings
ORDER BY nb_ratings DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which users co-reviewed the same movies more than twice?
cypher:
MATCH (u1:User)-[:RATED]->(m:Movie)<-[:RATED]-(u2:User)
WHERE id(u1) < id(u2)
WITH u1, u2, COUNT(DISTINCT m) AS common_movies
WHERE common_movies > 2
RETURN u1.name AS user1, u2.name AS user2, common_movies;
